question: Which NFA variant has the highest iron content, and what capacity did it keep at 1C in the rate test?
rendered: The NFA variant with the highest iron content is NFA-F (LiNi0.8Fe0.15Al0.05O2), which contains 15% iron. In the rate test, NFA-F maintained a capacity of approximately 81 mAh g−1 at 1C.
